sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
MOUSE with button='ACTION7' was executed (probably just a timer change). Dead end.
Let me think about the game design from a different angle.
Scene: a ball on a dotted 45° line, a movable purple square, a plus marker, a shrinking timer. This really looks like a "stop the ball" puzzle: the ball rolls down the line, and you place the square to stop it at the plus. But the ball doesn't roll on its own...
Or: the purple square is the player, and it moves one step along the line per action? Initially the square was at (58-60,3-5) — just past the end of the line (57,6). The plus at (53,10) = the next position on the line. When I clicked the plus, the square moved to the plus. So the plus indicates the square's next move, and clicking it advances the square one step toward the ball. The goal: move the square along the line all the way to the ball! When the square reaches the ball (or the ball's position), the level is cleared.
But after the move, the plus disappeared. Maybe the plus reappears at the next position after a delay, or maybe you have to click the square to make the next plus appear? Or maybe the plus only appears when the square is "armed."
Test: click the square at (53,10) — see if a new plus appears at (55,12)?? Wait, direction: the square moves from (53,10) toward the ball: next dot is (51,12)? No wait — the square is at (52-54,9-11), center (53,10). Dots on the line: (51,12) is up-right toward the ball. The square moves up the line toward the ball: (53,10) → (51,12)?? Hmm, but the square is 3x3 and the dots are 1px spaced by 2. The square's center moves 2 rows up, 2 cols right per step.
Actually, the initial square center is (59,4); the line's endpoint is (57,6). The plus center is (53,10). So the square jumped from (59,4) to (53,10) — that's 2 line steps (59,4)→(57,6)→(55,8)→(53,10)? The square's center (59,4) is not on the line (the line's endpoint is (57,6)). So the square jumped to the plus's position, which is on the line.
If the goal is "move the square to the plus," it's already done — but the level isn't cleared. So the goal must involve the ball.
Maybe: after placing the square at the plus, the ball rolls down the line, hits the square, and bounces back? And the ball needs to reach the top HUD square? Or the ball needs to be "captured" by the square.
Since SPACE is invalid and I can't find a trigger, maybe the ball rolls automatically when the timer bar hits 0. The timer decreases by 2 per playfield click (64→52 over 6 playfield clicks... let me count: initial 64; after 6 playfield clicks: 64,62,60,58,56,54,52 → 7 clicks? Currently 52). 26 more clicks to reach 0. That's a lot of actions, but it's deterministic. Hmm, but would the game design it that way? "Wait for the timer to run out and the ball drops" — possible!
Actually wait — maybe the ball rolls when the timer bar reaches a specific marker, not 0.
Or — the ball's rolling might be triggered by clicking the ball when the square is on the line. I clicked the ball at (15,48) with the square in the corner (step 1) — nothing happened. Now the square is on the line. Let me click the ball now and see if it rolls!
